description: The Kirchenfeld Bridge crosses high above the Aare on two riveted iron arches, seen from the riverbank. The deck is the 1883 high bridge, not the lower Nydegg Bridge, and the parliament building is not the subject. This replaces the Bundeshaus, already published. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, about 10°C, with full cloud cover, very humid air, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
